services.name: Facility Rentals
services.desc: The Rossland Museum & Discovery Centre is an exciting venue for your next event. The space rents for $300 per event (up to 4 hours). This price includes access to the museum and grounds. Our competitive rates compare favourably to other spaces of the same size and nature with the added benefit of a very unique atmosphere. A non-refundable $100 deposit is required to hold a reservation and an additional fee of $50 per hour is charged on rentals outside of our public operating hours. Rental discounts of 10% are available for museum members. The Rossland Museum & Discovery Centre offers 6000 square feet of rentable space and can comfortably accommodate parties of more than 100 guests indoors.

services.name: School Year Day Camps
services.desc: Travel back in time and activate your inner art historian with Spring Break Camps at the Rossland Museum! This year, campers have the opportunity to engage directly with some of our favourite art-related artefacts, most of which are not currently on display. For an artist, inspiration can come from anywhere, anytime. For us, inspiration comes from our collection, every day. Whether you're a mini Michaelangelo or more of a pint-sized Pollock, there's always a new medium to master or technique to try. By joining our Annual Donor Program - or by making a one-time or monthly gift - you are helping to preserve the stories and spirit of Rossland for generations to come.
